paragraphs: Yosef bar Chanin. Mentioned in Shabbat 115a, where he asked R' Abbahu a question.[^1][^2][^3]

notes.text: The supplied locator has קטו., rendered 115a under the period convention. The region and original entry boundary were recorded as provisional; an earlier heading audit had חנן instead of supplied חנין.

בעי מר׳ is read as “he asked R'” or “inquired of R'”; Yosef is the understood subject. The מ is the preposition “of/from,” and the personal-title component remains abbreviated. No independent identity is established.
This renders Hyman’s supplied citation; its occurrence and edition-specific locator have not been independently checked.
